headline: Accepted prior meeting minutes and signed the October 2026 motor vehicle abatement report.
summary: The meeting covered a department head meeting from November 4, 2026 and the fiscal 2026 pro rata supplemental billing. Afterward, the meeting went into executive session to review abatement and exemption applications, which state law limits to certain people.
decisions: Approved the open session and executive session minutes of October 27, 2026, by unanimous vote.
Signed the Motor Vehicle Abatement Report for October 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session meeting minutes of October 27, 2026
The Board signed the Motor Vehicle Abatement Report for the month of October 2026

decision_titles: Motor Vehicle Abatement Report for October 2026
plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – November 10, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of October 27, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Assessor discussed with the Board the Department Head Meeting held on November 4, 2026
The Board reviewed the Pro Rata Supplemental billing for fiscal 2026
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
The Board signed the Motor Vehicle Abatement Report for the month of October 2026
4.         Adjourned Open Session @ 5:25 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:25 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
